svg.title: The zdb forest: shared memtables at the top, each flushed as one L0 file into each of three tree pyramids, which then compact level by level
svg.desc: Writes from every table fill the active memtable, shared by all of them. When full it is frozen and flushed, each key routed to its own tree, producing one L0 SSTable per tree. Then each tree compacts its L0 into L1, one tree then compacts L1 into L2 and L2 into L3, and the cycle repeats.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ZDB · LSM FOREST · SHARED MEMTABLES · TREES PER TABLE AND INDEX
